limitations: This bounded trial does not establish full static-analysis correctness or LLM answer quality.
Byte counts are logical regular-file bytes; no compression, allocated-block or token claims.
The storage comparisons are calculated counterfactuals from measured sizes, not ten physical clones.
The environment/dependencies are shared and reported separately, excluded from both source/index comparisons.
Index keys include the absolute source location; relocation requires rebuilding the graph.
References are immutable by validation, not chmod; cooperating POSIX processes share locks.
Static source analysis is not proof of runtime reachability or a complete test selection system.
Cross-repository typed member-call success is a TypeScript fixture; it is not arbitrary HTTP service resolution.
Graphify query performs graph neighborhood retrieval; rg performs exact text matching. Latencies are not equivalent quality scores.
Five repeated samples are descriptive local timings, not a statistically representative performance benchmark.
Reported logical bytes are file contents, not allocated filesystem blocks, dependency footprint, or token counts.
Upstream path exits 0 when both nodes exist but no directed path exists; consumers must inspect the answer, not only the exit status.
Graphify query token_budget is a soft budget and can be exceeded; this suite records response bytes, not a hard token ceiling.
Native HTML export contains a vis-network script URL on unpkg.com; generation and embedded data are verified, browser interaction and CDN availability are not.
Fixture provenance is the recorded content hashes. An upstream graph built inside a Git checkout can inherit the enclosing Git HEAD even when the fixture is untracked.
Known-task replay on one public component; no blind evaluation or causal productivity claim.
Graphify returns graph neighborhoods; rg returns matching lines. Command timings are different operations.
AST direct-name calls are source evidence, not proof of runtime reachability or complete dependencies.
No baseline code is imported or executed; only the installed pinned Graphify processes it.
Graphify Git metadata can inherit the enclosing checkout; the source manifest identifies the actual frozen baseline.
Token budgets are upstream settings, not measured tokens. No provider or cost instrumentation is available.

measurements.coverage: This pilot process only; local child commands and explicit MCP requests. Excludes orchestrator/agent and provider activity.

limitations: One known public component and helper chain; not a blind or comprehensive evaluation.
Serve validates a snapshot at startup; source edits require restarting the MCP session.
Calls edges and AST source checks do not establish complete runtime semantics.
Shortest path considers containment too; the end-to-end route may use the file node. Each adjacent helper call is separately checked through real MCP shortest_path.
Source is read and parsed, never imported, built, or executed.
Per-operation elapsed time and bytes are observations, not speed or token-saving claims.
No global client configuration or model API is used. Provider/tokens/cost are unmeasured.

measurements.coverage: This trial process and explicit CLI/MCP operations only; excludes orchestrator and providers.
